mapper.select: SELECT FROM research_runs r JOIN projects p ON p.id=r.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM research_runs r JOIN projects p ON p.id=r.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE r.id=#{id} AND r.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.status<>'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE research_runs SET status=#{status},progress=CASE WHEN #{status}='COMPLETED' THEN 100 WHEN #{status} IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED') THEN progress ELSE 0 END,current_step=CASE WHEN #{status}='COMPLETED' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN #{status}='FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' WHEN #{status}='CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,started_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='RUNNING' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE started_at END,finished_at=CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('CANCELLED','FAILED','COMPLETED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE finished_at END,duration_seconds=CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('CANCELLED','FAILED','COMPLETED') AND started_at IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-started_at))::INTEGER ELSE duration_seconds END WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE')
